name: Cheeca Lodge & Spa
insider_take: This legendary Keys retreat sits on 27 pristine acres where the Atlantic meets Florida Bay, offering the perfect blend of luxury and authentic island charm.
whats_special: Cheeca Lodge is home to the only golf course in the Florida Keys - a 9-hole, par-3 Jack Nicklaus-designed course surrounded by crystal-clear waters. The resort also features its own private beach and the famous 525-foot fishing pier that extends into the Atlantic, making it a premier destination for world-class sportfishing including tarpon, bonefish, and permit.
pro_tip: Book treatments at the oceanfront Avanyu Spa during sunset hours - you'll enjoy panoramic water views while experiencing their signature conch shell massage ritual.
dont_miss: The nightly tarpon feeding from the fishing pier at dusk - these massive "silver kings" can grow up to 8 feet long and leap spectacularly out of the water. Also explore nearby Theater of the Sea, America's second-oldest marine mammal park, just minutes away for dolphin and sea lion encounters.
pros: Spectacular oceanfront location in the Florida Keys with pristine beaches
Comprehensive spa and wellness facilities with tropical treatments
Exceptional fishing opportunities including guided excursions and marina access
Multiple dining venues featuring fresh Keys cuisine and seafood specialties
Extensive recreational amenities including pools, tennis, and water sports
cons: Remote island location requires longer travel time to reach
Hurricane season may affect travel plans during summer months
